rows.ARS:
Mauve or mauve blend Large-Flowered Climber.
Registration name: WEKspitrib
Exhibition name: Purple Splash ®
rows.Origin:
Bred by Tom Carruth (United States, before 2007).
Introduced in United States by Weeks Wholesale Rose Grower, Inc. in 2010 as 'Purple Splash'.
rows.Bloom: Purple, white stripes. Moderate, spice, sweet fragrance. 8 to 12 petals. Average diameter 3". Medium, semi-double (9-16 petals), in large clusters, cupped bloom form. Blooms in flushes throughout the season. Ovoid buds.
rows.Habit:
Tall, climbing, spreading. Medium, glossy, medium green foliage. 3 to 7 leaflets.

Height: 9'10" to 13'1" (300 to 400cm).
rows.Growing: Can be used for cut flower, garden or pillar.
rows.Patents:
